description: Seed-ready dosage form master data for a pharmacy platform.

dosageForms.name: Tablet
dosageForms.description: Solid oral dosage form compressed from powdered ingredients, typically swallowed whole.

dosageForms.name: Capsule
dosageForms.description: Solid oral dosage form enclosed in a hard or soft gelatin shell containing powder, pellets, or liquid fill.

dosageForms.name: Softgel
dosageForms.description: Soft gelatin capsule containing a liquid or semi-solid fill, commonly used for oil-soluble supplements.

dosageForms.name: Chewable Tablet
dosageForms.description: Tablet designed to be chewed before swallowing, often flavoured for palatability in children.

dosageForms.name: Effervescent Tablet
dosageForms.description: Tablet dissolved in water before consumption that produces an effervescent solution.

dosageForms.name: Sublingual Tablet
dosageForms.description: Tablet placed under the tongue for rapid absorption directly into the bloodstream.

dosageForms.name: Oral Strip
dosageForms.description: Thin film strip placed on the tongue that dissolves rapidly for fast drug absorption.

dosageForms.name: Syrup
dosageForms.description: Sweetened liquid oral dosage form with active ingredients dissolved in a sugar or sugar-free base.

dosageForms.name: Suspension
dosageForms.description: Liquid dosage form containing undissolved fine particles dispersed in a liquid; must be shaken before use.

dosageForms.name: Liquid
dosageForms.description: General liquid oral preparation not classified as a syrup or suspension.

dosageForms.name: Drops
dosageForms.description: Concentrated liquid preparation administered in measured drops, used orally, ocularly, or nasally.

dosageForms.name: Nasal Drops
dosageForms.description: Liquid preparation administered into the nasal cavity using a dropper.

dosageForms.name: Sachet
dosageForms.description: Single-use sealed packet containing a measured dose of powder or granules dissolved in water before use.

dosageForms.name: Granules
dosageForms.description: Small particle preparations of medicine typically dissolved in water or taken directly.

dosageForms.name: Powder
dosageForms.description: Dry powdered preparation used for oral reconstitution, topical application, or inhalation.

dosageForms.name: Injection
dosageForms.description: Sterile parenteral dosage form administered via intravenous, intramuscular, or subcutaneous routes.

dosageForms.name: IV Infusion
dosageForms.description: Large-volume sterile solution administered slowly into a vein over an extended period.

dosageForms.name: Cream
dosageForms.description: Semi-solid emulsion-based topical preparation for application to skin or mucous membranes.

dosageForms.name: Ointment
dosageForms.description: Greasy, anhydrous or water-in-oil semi-solid topical preparation for prolonged skin contact.

dosageForms.name: Eye Ointment
dosageForms.description: Sterile ointment formulated for application to the eye or eyelid margins.

dosageForms.name: Gel
dosageForms.description: Semi-solid preparation with a gel-like consistency for topical use, offering a cooling effect.

dosageForms.name: Lotion
dosageForms.description: Low-viscosity liquid topical preparation applied to the skin for moisturising or medicinal purposes.

dosageForms.name: Spray
dosageForms.description: Liquid or aerosol preparation dispensed as a fine mist for nasal, oral, or topical application.

dosageForms.name: Inhaler
dosageForms.description: Device that delivers medicine directly into the lungs as a metered aerosol or dry powder.

dosageForms.name: Nebulizer Solution
dosageForms.description: Liquid medicine converted into a mist by a nebulizer device for inhalation into the lungs.

dosageForms.name: Patch
dosageForms.description: Transdermal adhesive patch delivering a controlled dose of medicine through the skin over time.

dosageForms.name: Suppository
dosageForms.description: Solid dosage form designed for insertion into the rectum, vagina, or urethra where it dissolves.

dosageForms.name: Emulsion
dosageForms.description: Biphasic liquid preparation of oil and water stabilised by an emulsifier for oral or topical use.

dosageForms.name: Enema
dosageForms.description: Liquid preparation administered rectally for bowel evacuation or local drug delivery.

dosageForms.name: Other
dosageForms.description: Other or miscellaneous dosage form not covered by the standard categories.
